reviewCharts.warning: North Carolina native review rows use the official NCSBE Real Precinct=Y filter for precinct-only presidential vote-share screening and presidential-versus-Governor same-party drop-off screening. Certified county totals still aggregate all official reporting units, including early voting, absentee, provisional, and transfer rows. The comparison contest is Governor, not U.S. Senate, because North Carolina did not have a 2024 U.S. Senate race.

turnout.notes: North Carolina turnout rows use EAC 2024 V2 county/jurisdiction fallback rows. Official NCSBE voter_stats and history_stats ZIPs are retained as state-native denominator/turnout leads, but history_stats voter totals require ballots-cast semantic review before replacement.

historicalBaselines.warning: North Carolina historical baseline rows are county-level presidential aggregates generated from official NCSBE 2012, 2016, and 2020 precinct results ZIPs. Use them as contextual baselines, not as 2024 certified data or precinct-sort geometry.

historicalReview.warning: North Carolina 2016 historical advisory rows aggregate every official President and U.S. Senate reporting row by the explicit source County field and make no precinct-level claim. The 2020 rows include only official same-grain keys marked Real Precinct=Y; 403 Real Precinct=N administrative keys are excluded and exactly reconciled. Candidate and contest differences can explain the calculated patterns. Advisory indicators are review signals, not proof of fraud or misconduct.
